## Project

Under-invoicing at customs reduces revenue and can distort competition between firms. Working with Pakistan's Federal Board of Revenue, this project evaluates two reforms: faceless customs assessment, which separates assessors from traders, and upgrades to the risk-management system using additional third-party information.

The analysis studies processing efficiency, revenue recovery, and the detection of evasion, while measuring whether institutional redesign changes the discretion and performance of customs assessment.
